nodes.label: php-imap Module: Optional Extension Design
nodes.rationale: The php-imap module is optional because the IMAP protocol is fully implemented in PHP natively, enabling use without the extension. The extension can be enabled for edge cases, improved decoding quality, and legacy protocols like POP3.
